subject: START statement
notes:
kb/Work PB352. RULE: "The open mode of the file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall be input or I-O." (cite.py --check 14.9.41.4 "The open mode of the file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall be input or I-O." -> OK §14.9.41.4 1)). The unsuccessful status is §9.1.13.7 item 7 (--check 9.1.13.7 "not open in the input or I-O mode" -> OK, item 7 = '47'). CODE: both keyed connectors open their START bodies with `if (!IsOpen || Mode is FileOpenMode.Output or FileOpenMode.Extend) return Status = FileStatusCode.ReadNotOpenForInput;` and FileStatus.cs:76 pins RecordNotFound='23' / ReadNotOpenForInput='47'. MEASURED (probe start-p2-i, relative DYNAMIC): OPEN OUTPUT -> FS=47, OPEN EXTEND -> FS=47, OPEN I-O -> FS=00; (probe start-p2-b T7, indexed) OPEN OUTPUT -> FS=47. WHY NOT CONFORMS: GR1 is stated before the RELATIVE FILES heading, so it governs SEQUENTIAL organization too, and that arm never reaches the check — KeyedIoBinder.BindStart L207-L210 turns `START <sequential-file> FIRST` into a BoundUnsupported, which COMPILES and then aborts the run unit with an unhandled WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime.NotImplementedCobolFeatureException (probe start-p2-h). GR-14.9.41.4-20/-21 (part 3) own the primary rows for that arm; recorded here because it leaves one third of GR1's domain unhonoured. No spec-derived test exercises the '47' leg (KeyedIoDifferentialTests is DifferentialGolden.Assert against the legacy oracle and cannot close a row). || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 / 2002 / 2014 / 2023 — GR1 has no edition marker in the clause and Annex E (the 2023-vs-2014 delta) lists no START change, so the rule reads identically at every edition the compiler targets.

LANDED 2026-09-05 (kb/Work PB352). The third of GR1's domain that was unhonoured - sequential organization - now runs the rule: SequentialConnector.StartFirstLast exists and answers 47 for OPEN OUTPUT / OPEN EXTEND. The rule also stopped being five copies of itself: FileConnector.StartOpenModeGuard is the ONE site, shaped like 14.9.30.4's READ preconditions (kb/Work PB336), and every connector delegates. WOUT=47 in conformance:cases/9.1.13.5-Invalid-key-condition-with-unsuccessful-completion/pb352_start_sequential_first_last pins the sequential 47 with neither INVALID nor NOT INVALID running; conformance:cases/9.1.13.2-Successful-completion/l1_table20_seq_relative walks the Sequential row's four START cells (Input 00, Output 47, I-O 00, Extend 47) and conformance:cases/14.9.27-OPEN/l1_table20_indexed the indexed twin.
